steps.title: Activate and aliquot Streptolysin O
steps.instruction: Open the lyophilized SLO bottle, add 500 µL PBS + 10 mM DTT, invert and vortex briefly to resuspend, incubate at 37 °C for 2 h to pre‑activate, determine protein concentration with the Bio‑Rad protein assay dye, snap‑freeze 10 µL aliquots in liquid nitrogen and store at –80 °C (avoid repeat freeze‑thaw cycles).

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL PBS + 10 mM DTT to lyophilized SLO.
Resuspend by inverting multiple times and brief vortex.
Incubate bottle at 37 °C for 2 h (pre‑activation).
Measure protein concentration using the protein assay dye reagent.
Aliquot 10 µL into pre‑chilled tubes, snap‑freeze in liquid nitrogen.
Store aliquots at –80 °C until use in later procedures.

steps.title: Harvest and isolate cytosol from HCT116 WT cells
steps.instruction: Grow HCT116 WT cells to 95 % confluence in 20 mm × 150 mm plates (30 mL DMEM + 10 % FBS), place plates on ice, aspirate medium, wash each plate with 10 mL cold PBS, scrape cells into 1 mL cold PBS + protease inhibitors per plate (collect five plates together), centrifuge 200 × g 5 min 4 °C, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 3 mL cold hypotonic lysis buffer, incubate on ice 15 min, transfer to a pre‑chilled 7 mL dounce and homogenize ~80 strokes (tight pestle), centrifuge 1,000 × g 15 min 4 °C (Sorvall ST16R, TX‑200 rotor) to remove unruptured cells, collect ~3–4 mL post‑nuclear supernatant, ultracentrifuge ~128,000 × g (32,500 rpm) 30 min 4 °C (Optima XE‑90, SW 55 Ti rotor) to pellet membranes, transfer cytosol‑containing supernatant to a 4 mL Amicon Ultra‑15 3 kDa concentrator, centrifuge 4,000 × g for six successive 10‑min spins at 4 °C (resuspending after each spin) while monitoring protein loss with the assay dye, measure final protein concentration (≈40 mg/mL), aliquot, snap‑freeze in liquid nitrogen and store at –80 °C (avoid repeat freeze‑thaw).

substeps.instruction: Culture cells to 95 % confluence in 30 mL DMEM + 10 % FBS.
Place plates on ice, aspirate medium, wash with 10 mL cold PBS per plate.
Harvest cells with 1 mL cold PBS + protease inhibitors per plate; combine five plates.
Centrifuge 200 × g 5 min 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 3 mL cold hypotonic lysis buffer, incubate on ice 15 min.
Transfer to 7 mL dounce, homogenize ~80 strokes (tight pestle).
Centrifuge 1,000 × g 15 min 4 °C (Sorvall ST16R, TX‑200 rotor).
Collect ~3–4 mL post‑nuclear supernatant.
Ultracentrifuge ~128,000 × g (32,500 rpm) 30 min 4 °C (Optima XE‑90, SW 55 Ti rotor).
Transfer supernatant to 4 mL Amicon Ultra‑15 3 kDa filter.
Centrifuge 4,000 × g for six 10‑min intervals at 4 °C, resuspending each time; monitor protein loss with assay dye.
Measure protein concentration (target ≈40 mg/mL).
Aliquot cytosol, snap‑freeze in liquid nitrogen, store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Permeabilize CD63‑Nluc cells with SLO
steps.instruction: Seed HCT116 CD63‑Nluc cells in 24‑well PDL‑coated plates to ~80 % confluence (three technical replicates per condition). Keep plates on ice, aspirate medium, wash each well with 500 µL cold PBS + 1 mM EGTA, aspirate, add 200 µL SLO binding buffer, shake at 4 °C on a lateral shaker 15 min, aspirate and wash with 500 µL cold transport buffer, aspirate and add 500 µL pre‑warmed permeabilization buffer, incubate 37 °C 10 min, assess permeabilization under a phase‑contrast microscope (10× objective; nucleoli should be distinct, 95–100 % cells permeabilized), return plate to ice, replace with 500 µL cold transport buffer, shake 4 °C 10 min, replace with 500 µL cold high‑salt transport buffer, shake 4 °C 10 min, finally replace with 500 µL cold transport buffer and shake 4 °C 10 min. The plate is now ready for reaction assembly.

substeps.instruction: Culture cells to ~80 % confluence in 24‑well PDL plates (triplicates).
Place plate on ice, aspirate conditioned medium.
Wash each well with 500 µL cold PBS + 1 mM EGTA; aspirate.
Add 200 µL SLO binding buffer, shake at 4 °C 15 min (lateral shaker).
Aspirate, wash with 500 µL cold transport buffer; aspirate.
Add 500 µL pre‑warmed permeabilization buffer, incubate 37 °C 10 min.
Assess permeabilization using a 10× objective phase‑contrast microscope (nucleoli distinct, 95–100 % permeabilized).
Return plate to ice, replace with 500 µL cold transport buffer, shake 4 °C 10 min.
Replace with 500 µL cold high‑salt transport buffer, shake 4 °C 10 min.
Replace with 500 µL cold transport buffer, shake 4 °C 10 min.

steps.title: Prepare reaction mixes for exosome reconstitution
steps.instruction: In low‑retention tubes assemble 200 µL reaction mixes (final concentrations: 1 mM ATP, 40 mM creatine phosphate, 0.2 mg/mL creatine phosphokinase, 0.15 mM GTP, 4 mg/mL cytosol, 2 mM CaCl₂ as required). Use the example volumes from Table 1: transport buffer 221.2 µL, 10× ATP regeneration system 25 µL, 10 mM GTP 3.8 µL, cytosol (40 mg/mL) 25 µL (only for conditions needing cytosol), 100 mM CaCl₂ 5 µL (only for Ca²⁺ conditions). Adjust volumes for each condition so total volume equals 250 µL before aliquoting 200 µL into the wells.

substeps.instruction: Add 221.2 µL transport buffer to each tube.
Add 25 µL 10× ATP regeneration system (contains 1 mM ATP, 40 mM creatine phosphate, 0.2 mg/mL creatine phosphokinase).
Add 3.8 µL 10 mM GTP (final 0.15 mM).
If the condition requires cytosol, add 25 µL cytosol (40 mg/mL) to reach 4 mg/mL final.
If the condition requires Ca²⁺, add 5 µL 100 mM CaCl₂ to reach 2 mM final.
Mix gently; total volume per tube = 250 µL.
Aliquot 200 µL of each mix into the corresponding well of the 24‑well plate.

steps.title: Add reaction mix and incubate cells
steps.instruction: Aspirate the cold transport buffer from the permeabilized cells (step 3 final), add 200 µL of the appropriate reaction mix to each well, incubate the plate on ice 5 min, then place the plate in a 30 °C water bath for 2 min to stimulate exosome secretion, return the plate to ice.

substeps.instruction: Remove transport buffer from each well.
Add 200 µL reaction mix to each well.
Incubate on ice 5 min.
Transfer plate to 30 °C water bath 2 min.
Return plate to ice.

steps.title: Collect supernatant and lyse cells
steps.instruction: Load 100 µL of each reaction supernatant onto an AcroPrep 96‑well 0.4 µm filter plate positioned over a 96‑well collection plate, centrifuge 1,500 × g 1 min 4 °C (Eppendorf 5810 R, A‑4‑62 swinging‑bucket rotor). While the centrifuge runs, add 100 µL cold transport buffer + 2 % TX‑100 (with protease inhibitors) to each well of the original 24‑well plate (final 1 % TX‑100) to lyse the cells and collect the lysate for normalization.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 100 µL supernatant from each well to the corresponding well of the 0.4 µm filter plate.
Centrifuge filter plate at 1,500 × g for 1 min at 4 °C.
Add 100 µL cold transport buffer + 2 % TX‑100 (protease inhibitors) to each well of the 24‑well plate (final 1 % TX‑100) to lyse cells.
Collect the cell lysate for later normalization.

steps.title: Measure luminescence for exosome secretion
steps.instruction: For each filtrate sample, add 50 µL filtrate to a microcentrifuge tube, add 100 µL Nluc substrate/inhibitor master mix, vortex ~1 s, read luminescence on a Promega Glowmax 20/20 (Measurement A). Then add 1.5 µL 10 % TX‑100 (final 0.1 %) to the same tube, vortex ~1 s, read luminescence again (Measurement B). For normalization, add 50 µL cell lysate to a new tube, add 50 µL Nluc lytic master mix, vortex ~1 s, read luminescence (Measurement C). Use Measurement A to quantify exosome‑associated CD63‑Nluc, subtract Measurement B as background, and divide by Measurement C to normalize across samples.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL filtrate to a tube; add 100 µL Nluc substrate/inhibitor master mix; vortex 1 s; measure luminescence (Measurement A).
Add 1.5 µL 10 % TX‑100 (final 0.1 %); vortex 1 s; measure luminescence (Measurement B).
Add 50 µL cell lysate to a new tube; add 50 µL Nluc lytic master mix; vortex 1 s; measure luminescence (Measurement C).
